description: Read XRPL server_info for node health, server state, and validated-ledger status. Use this when an agent needs to determine whether the node is healthy/current before interpreting ledger-dependent results; use n9t2_xrpl_get_ledger for ledger metadata or n9t2_xrpl_get_ledger_data for ledger entries. Takes no parameters.
name: n9t2_xrpl_get_server_info
